reviewSummary: REJECT at 1 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Custody, modes, hashes, live HEAD, COORD, file 08, lineage, authority limits, closure arrays, and the non-remasure guards all pass. The load-bearing payload semantics do not: 00010000 is the permitted preHandshake value N=65536, for which prefix-only refusal does not apply, yet the finite four-byte file contains zero of the exactly 65536 body bytes required by the quoted frame rule. It is therefore a truncated-body/EOF input if the file is consumed as the complete injection, or only an incomplete prefix fragment if the stream remains open. The candidate nevertheless calls it a complete exact-bound injection and repeatedly asserts that it is not truncated-body. Deferring stale-authoring measurement and declining to pin prefix-only RF-2 preserve authority boundaries but do not make that byte classification true.

mustFix.title: The alleged non-truncated exact-bound injection contains none of its required body
mustFix.claimUnderReview: The subject claims that a four-byte N=65536 payload with no body is a complete G21.cc5.prefix-exactly-at-prehandshake injection and is not truncated-body, while candidly declining to treat N=65536 as prefix-only RF-2.
primaryEvidence: The quoted frame rule requires a 4-byte N followed by exactly N body bytes.
The quoted preHandshake refusal predicate is N greater than 65536 or N equal to 0. For N=65536 both disjuncts are false, so the receiver cannot reject this prefix as oversize and avoid the body.
The payload is exactly 00010000: N=65536 followed by zero body bytes. It therefore lacks all 65536 bytes required by the frame rule.

If the finite file is the whole injected stream, EOF occurs while the receiver awaits the body, which is the contract's truncated-body case. If EOF is not delivered, the file is merely a prefix fragment and does not by itself implement a complete exact-bound injection.

The subject nevertheless repeats 'This injection is not truncated-body' and uses the catalog standing AUTHORED-BYTES-EXIST for the claimed injection. Its expected field also requires uncommitted candidates to be discarded without identifying any lawful fault other than the truncation it denies.
mustFix.whyMustFix: This is the sole catalog member and the central authoring claim. Naming the mutation differently cannot override the frame grammar. A later harness consuming the file as a finite injection would exercise EOF/truncation, not a clean exact-bound frame, while a harness keeping the stream open would have no complete case to score. Deferring the later stale-authoring measurement keeps OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING open, but it does not make the proposed fixture implementation semantically coherent enough to record.
mustFix.requiredRemedy: Do not record this frozen v34. In a successor, choose one coherent construction without pinning N=65536 as prefix-only RF-2: either (a) describe and catalog these four bytes only as an incomplete prefix fragment, keep the exact-bound injection unauthored, and remove the non-truncated and complete-injection claims; (b) provide a complete delivery/session fixture with the required body and an expected property that first admits the legal N=65536 prefix; or (c) keep the finite four-byte/EOF input but classify it as truncated-body and do not claim it authors exact-bound coverage. Preserve the frozen subject and payload while repairing in a successor.
